description: Abstract class defining cache management for HTML definitions in the HTMLPurifier library, including methods for cache key generation, validation, and management.

classes.name: HTMLPurifier_DefinitionCache
classes.description: Abstract class providing common methods for cache managers handling HTML definitions, including key generation, validation, and cache operations.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the cache with a specific type of definition objects it will handle.

methods.name: generateKey
methods.description: Creates a unique cache key based on the configuration version, batch serial, and revision.

methods.name: isOld
methods.description: Determines if a cache key is outdated compared to the current configuration.

methods.name: checkDefType
methods.description: Verifies that a definition object's type matches the cache's type, triggers an error if not.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Abstract method to add a definition object to the cache.

methods.name: set
methods.description: Abstract method to unconditionally save a definition object to the cache.

methods.name: replace
methods.description: Abstract method to replace an object in the cache.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Abstract method to retrieve a definition object from the cache.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Abstract method to remove a definition object from the cache.

methods.name: flush
methods.description: Abstract method to clear all objects from the cache.

methods.name: cleanup
methods.description: Abstract method to remove expired cache objects based on version or revision.
